facts.statement: The research was a retrospective cohort study of stroke patients one year after their event.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The study included 197 stroke survivors who were assessed at a median of 386 days after their stroke.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: 79% of the participants reported high medication adherence, although many did not understand the reason for taking their drugs.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: No significant differences in medication adherence were found between different ethnicities or sexes.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: Longer hospital stays, greater post-stroke disability, and caregiver involvement were associated with high medication adherence.
facts.subject: humans

facts.statement: The lowest levels of medication adherence were observed in patients who had mild strokes.
facts.subject: humans
